To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
premilling treatments have a great impact on wheat flour quality, which is reflected by its effect on noodle quality.
acid treatment of wheat grains deteriorates the quality of wheat flour, gluten and noodle.
premilling treatments improve the wheat flour quality, which in turn improve the quality of the wheat noodles prepared from them.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of different milling treatments on wheat gluten content and its quality.
the effect of different milling treatments on wheat gluten content, gluten quality, and noodle quality.
the effect of four different milling treatments on wheat flour quality and their utilization for the preparation of noodles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of wheat flour and noodle quality can be significantly improved by using appropriate and proper treatment before milling.
the wheat flour quality is improved with the application of conditioning and yeast treatments, while the quality of wheat flour is reduced with the application of acid treatment.
premilling treatments have a significant effect on gluten extraction and quality as well as on wheat flour and noodle quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality and quantity of gluten can be enhanced by proper premilling treatments.
the quality of gluten extracted from flours and quality of noodles prepared with flours are significantly affected by the different premilling treatments.
premilling treatment is an important step in wheat milling process and can significantly improve the quality of wheat flour and its products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of the flour obtained after premilling treatment is directly related to noodle quality.
wheat flours with better quality can be obtained by conditioning and yeast treatment and the quality of noodles can be improved using conditioning and yeast treatment.
the premilling treatments significantly influence the quality of gluten and noodle quality.
